title: Full B2 coefficient4 with polylogarithmic design seed and O(log(N)^15 loglog(N)^43) loss

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"One fixed total scale-header language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. At large actual length N the first L=ceil(log2 N) input bits encode S-1. Every scale1<=S<=2^L is evaluated, rejected large plans give zero, and the finite small cutoff uses the fixed legacy evaluator. Put z=ceil(log2 L). Exact parameters are k=P2(S^13 L^15 z^43),h=e=P2(S L^2 z^5),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^13),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^18),d=P2(S^9 L^10 z^33),Y=P2(S^11 L^13 z^38). Independence order h is separate from binary index alphabet2, with d0 rounds. Initial dimension10000 is fixed, five internal dimensions equal z, and design dimension equals w=ceil(log2 r). Robust design uses m=floor(delta*r), b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^5/(30*10^24)), u=2b+2w+10, delta=10^-12. Its hash field degree is1000w; fresh A1 precision101w+10, largest admissible chunks and O(w^3) calls use O(w^5) seed. Every header and field/matrix datum is an actual input bit; large condenser fields are computed deterministically. Existence of one fixed S0 proves only restriction hardness; evaluation and NP eligibility hold on every header and data string. No advice, witness or good parameter is supplied externally.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and hence NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^15*(log2(log2 N))^43. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^15*(log2(log2 N))^(43+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(15+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. The proof fixes one ordinary constant header S0. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=L+O(S0^5 L^6 z^20)=o(k). The supplied gate theorem4n-8d covers all16 B2 tables and arbitrary sharing. The supplied robust-function moment proof has degree and log-error threshold O(r^2*u). Layout coverage loses only a factor2^O_S0((log r)^4), so actual bad-coordinate accounting still holds. Neither an explicit numerical B nor efficient search for S0 is asserted or needed for eligibility.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: Supplemental local lemma under elimination.md Sections 1-4 and 8: in the injective matching-quadratic representation with potential H=2s+3q+sum of unpaired weights 0,6,7 at degrees 0,1,at least 2, assume the preliminary exclusions and prepared minimal AND G on distinct unpaired x,y of degrees u,v>=2. If G has exactly one child D, no child of G reads x or y, and D is AND-type with an unpaired isolated other parent z, let j count common children of x,y other than G. There is a legal restriction/deletion reduction with Delta a=-2 and Delta H<=-20-2(u+v-j). If the value of G that forces D constant is its majority output value, there is also a legal reduction with Delta a=-1 and Delta H<=-15-2*max(u,v). Both statements allow D to be the output, count shared original objects only once, preserve the representation on every remaining assignment, and do not assert any improvement of the leading scored coefficient.

Supplemental local lemma under elimination.md Sections 1-3 and 9: assume preliminary cases 1-5 absent in the same injective matching-quadratic representation and a>d. Any AND-type acyclic gate G with a paired parameter p as one input can be removed, together with its original children, by fixing p to a forcing constant and removing its pair. The other input may be a parameter, an auxiliary value or a gate. The reduction deletes only G and its original children, retaining other objects for later cleanup. The gate cannot be the output under these hypotheses. If t>=1 is its number of distinct children, t_1 counts those whose other input was an isolated unpaired parameter, and B is the unique child of the partner h of p, then Delta a=0 and Delta H<=1-2t+t_1<=0 when B is not a child of G; when B is a child, Delta H<=2-2t+t_1<=0 with t_1<=t-1. Shared descendants and arbitrary rerouting fan-out are covered. The operation preserves the representation, introduces no gate, and asserts no larger leading coefficient.

For every total Boolean function f on n bits that is nonconstant on every dimension-d affine subspace of F_2^n (integers n>=0,d>=1), every circuit computing f in the pinned full B2 model has at least (7/2)n-(13/2)d gates. This universal finite gate theorem is proved by the matching-quadratic representation and reweighted potential J=2s+2q+sum of unpaired weights 0,5,6 at degrees 0,1,at least2, with complete modified isolated-input and AND-child reductions in elimination.md Section10. If d>n the stated bound is nonpositive.

For every total Boolean function f on n bits that is nonconstant on every dimension-d affine subspace of F_2^n (integers n>=0,d>=1), every circuit computing f in the pinned full B2 model has at least 4n-10d gates. The supplied proof is elimination.md Section11: Phi is injective affine, correctness is maintained only on Z(P) where each disjoint paired product is zero, and W=s+4q+6I has Delta W<=10 Delta(m-q) under a complete deletion, paired-cleanup and minimal-AND analysis. The result covers arbitrary sharing, all binary tables and terminal outputs.

For every total Boolean function f on n bits that is nonconstant on every dimension-d affine subspace of F_2^n (integers n>=0,d>=1), every circuit computing f in the pinned full B2 model has at least 4n-8d gates. elimination.md Section12 proves that the two-paired-input case removes four distinct original gates, including when partner children or descendants coincide; constant-output exceptions contradict the surviving dimension-d affine space. Reweighting all supplied Section11 cases with V=s+2q+4I yields Delta V<=8 Delta(m-q), proving the bound with no additional hardness or model assumption.

experiments.purpose: Supplementary exact finite checks of full-B2 local identities and potential arithmetic, retained algebraic fixtures, deterministic tower/PV expansion and linearity, exact threshold/layout arithmetic, and bounded evaluator traversal. These computations do not establish universal extraction coverage, all-length asymptotics, or the enormous complete advanced family evaluation.
